headline: GE Vernova (GEV) Deploys AirJoule Water System At Frontier Campus
summary: AirJoule Technologies has deployed its atmospheric water generation system at GE Vernova’s new Advanced Research Center Frontier Campus. The installation provides a live demonstration of AirJoule’s technology for industrial and data center water and energy needs. This is the first time the GE Vernova and AirJoule collaboration has been implemented and publicized at this scale. GE Vernova, NYSE:GEV, is using the Frontier Campus as a showcase for applied research in power and energy...

headline: GE Vernova Wins Contract to Modernise Dinorwig Hydropower Plant in Wales
summary: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) has secured a contract from First Hydro Company, a joint venture between ENGIE and La Caisse, to replace two pumped storage generating units at the Dinorwig pumped storage hydropower station in North Wales. The project forms part of a long-term modernisation programme designed to extend the operational life of one of the UK’s most important energy storage facilities.
